title: 第23章 早朝风波第24章 以退为进
slug: 穿成皇子六连抽建立万古帝朝
lines: 萧风带着萧雅回到了汉王府，随后让曹正淳先将萧雅送回房间，随后便招来了贾诩，三人又进了书房。
落座之后，萧风开口道：“丞相已经答应明日早朝之时由他提出让我担任四朝比试的主官，但是我现在摸不清楚父皇的想法，不知道能不能顺利的担任。”

“殿下无需担心，即使明天陛下没有答应，我们还能想办法，袁天罡已经将四朝比试的内容和以往的资料送过来，比试的内容一般分为：第一种每个王朝出5个人，进行个人战，年龄不得超过25，分组抽签，最后取积分排名为主；第二种，还是每个王朝出5个人，进行团队战，年龄不得超过30，同样是抽签决定；第三种，每个王朝派出5位皇子或者是宗亲，进行比试，年龄不得超过20，但是这次是按照排名来确定顺序。这三种无论是哪一种，殿下都能参与到其中，特别是第三种，以目前袁天罡收集到的资料来看，只有只有紫云王朝的三皇子是黄阶巅峰的修为，其余大部分参赛的人员都是黄阶中级左右的，所以如果是第三种模式，那殿下肯定能拔得头筹。”
萧风听了贾诩的话，也是把心放在肚子里，根据贾诩的说法，无论哪一种，萧风肯定都能入选，毕竟他的实力，萧鼎锋是清楚的，哪怕宗室还有天才少年，但是肯定在名额中也能有一个他的位置。
随后，萧风挥了挥手，示意贾诩和曹正淳散去休息，两人也是向萧风行了个礼，转身离开了书房，回去休息。而萧风也是向着自己的房间走去。
进入房间后，萧风看着窗外的月光，并没有像以往一样，开始修炼，而是突然想起刚刚在丞相府的时候，凉亭中呼延欢颜的侧颜，月光洒在那侧颜上，有种说不出的美，想到这里，萧风的嘴角也是不自觉地上扬，露出了一抹十分浓郁的笑意。
这抹笑意中蕴含着对呼延欢颜深深的欣赏和喜爱之情。想到这里，萧风随即便沉沉的睡去了。
第二日早朝，众皇子和大臣早早的来到了勤政殿，经过昨夜的讨论，各自阵营都讨论出来了一个结果，所以都想着今日早朝能将四朝比试的事情敲定下来，让自己主子夺嫡的希望能更进一步。
“陛下驾到”刘雨的声音传来，刚刚还在窃窃私语的朝臣，立刻安静下来，萧鼎锋也是坐在了上方，直接开口道：“四朝比试的事情，今天下午就会抽签决定本次的比试内容，大家现在有什么想法，都可以说出来听听。”
各自皇子的支持者立刻都出来说让自己主子来担任本次的主官，一时间各位大臣开始像是在菜市场买菜一样，来回吵闹，而丞相一脉和中立一派，就默默地站在一旁，好像这件事和他们没有关系一样。
“够了！吵吵闹闹的像什么样子？你们以为这里是哪里？看看你们自己的样子！”萧鼎锋突然夹杂着气势的开口，让整个朝堂瞬间安静下来。
刚刚还在吵吵嚷嚷的众臣，全部都不说话了。
这时萧鼎锋开口问道：“丞相，你觉得此事应该交由谁来主办？”
“陛下，微臣决定，还是要先确定本次比试的内容，确定下来之后，咱们才应该考虑这些，微臣以为，当下要做好多种准备，首先要确定能代表咱们旭日王朝出战的人员，当确定本次比试内容后，咱们再安排谁来主办，不管谁来主办此事，都必须是在陛下的旨意下办事，因为这件事可是关乎着咱们旭日王朝五年内的发展，上次的比试咱们差一点就垫底，本次一定要拿到好名次，要不然年轻一代会被拉开太远的差距的。”
萧鼎锋听到呼延墨岩的话也是有些意外，因为他知道昨日萧风去拜访了呼延墨岩，估计也能猜到除了去看看呼延欢颜以外，更重要的是去和呼延墨岩商量本次比试的事情，没想到的是呼延墨岩竟然没有直接帮助萧风，这让萧鼎锋很是满意。
于是便开口道：“你们看看，丞相的格局，你们一个一个的都在争这个位子，却没有想到这个位子对本朝有何影响，你们现在谁能站出来说你能争到第一，那我便让谁来坐这个主官。”
萧鼎锋看着一众皇子，众皇子却都低下了头，只有萧风像是什么事情都没发生一样，依然看着一旁，虽然他很想站出来，但是呼延墨岩刚刚的话已经点醒他了，不要强出头，要顺其自然，所以他也没有站出来。
萧鼎锋说道：“想参加的皇子一会和我说，宗室那边鼎南，你去通知一下，符合条件的让他们和你报名，你筛选一下。”
“微臣领命。”萧鼎南站出来说道。
“至于你们各自想参加的可以上折子，等下午抽完签，朕会对这些人再进行筛选。”
“萧凯，你下午随朕参加抽签，至于其他的皇子，出了结果，朕会派人通知你们。”萧鼎锋说完便宣布了退朝。
众人看萧鼎锋走了，也开始都退出了勤政殿，几位皇子也是走出了勤政殿，并没有去御书房，因为刚刚刘雨过来说陛下要在御书房见其他几个王朝的代表，让他们不用过去了，只有大皇子萧凯跟着刘雨去了御书房。
萧风也是走着很慢，他想问问呼延墨岩，这件事怎么处理，他走出勤政殿的时候，看到了等在一旁的呼延墨岩，呼延墨岩看着萧风出来，也是走了上来，说道：“去我府上吧，你不是约了欢颜下午要陪她吗？”
萧风点了点头，出宫后，萧风邀请呼延墨岩坐他的马车，于是呼延墨岩就上了萧风的马车，刚刚进入马车便看到了在车内等候的贾诩，呼延墨岩愣了一下，显然没想到车内还有个人。
萧风坐到车内后，也是给呼延墨岩介绍起来：“岳父，这是我身边的谋士，贾诩。”
贾诩躬身道：“参见丞相大人。”
呼延墨岩摆了摆手，开口道：“你是萧风的谋士，无需多礼，以后还希望你多多的辅佐风儿。”
“文和，自当为殿下肝脑涂地。”贾诩也是开口回道。
“好了，都不要客气了，都是自己人，就不要这么见外了。”

content_en:
Xiao Feng took Xiao Ya back to the Han Palace, and then asked Cao Zhengchun to send Xiao Ya back to the room first, then called Jia Xu, and the three of them entered the study again.
After sitting down, Xiao Feng said: "The Prime Minister has promised that he will ask me to serve as the chief officer of the Four Dynasties Competition tomorrow morning. However, I don't know what my father's thoughts are now, and I don't know if I can successfully take up the role."
"Your Majesty, there is no need to worry. Even if His Majesty does not agree tomorrow, we can still find a way. Yuan Tiangang has sent over the content of the Four Dynasties Competition and past information. The content of the competition is generally divided into: the first type, each dynasty will send out 5 people for individual battles, the age must not exceed 25, the group draws lots, and the final ranking will be based on points; the second type, each dynasty will send out 5 people for team battles, the age must not exceed 30, the same is determined by drawing lots; the third type, each king will The imperial court sent five princes or clan members to compete. The age should not be more than 20, but this time the order is determined by ranking. Regardless of the three types, His Highness can participate, especially the third type. Judging from the information collected by Yuan Tiangang, only the third prince of the Ziyun Dynasty has a peak Huang level, and most of the other participants are around the middle level of the Yellow level. So if it is the third mode, His Highness will definitely come out on top. "
Xiao Feng listened to Jia Xu's words and took it to heart. According to Jia Xu, no matter which one, Xiao Feng will definitely be selected. After all, Xiao Dingfeng knows his strength. Even if there are talented young people in the clan, there will definitely be a place for him in the quota.
Then, Xiao Feng waved his hand, signaling Jia Xu and Cao Zhengchun to go and rest. The two of them also saluted Xiao Feng, turned around, left the study, and went back to rest. And Xiao Feng also walked towards his room.
After entering the room, Xiao Feng looked at the moonlight outside the window. He did not start practicing as before, but suddenly remembered the happy face in the pavilion when he was in the Prime Minister's Mansion. The moonlight shone on that profile, and there was an indescribable beauty. Thinking of this, the corners of Xiao Feng's mouth also unconsciously raised, revealing a very rich smile.
This smile contains deep appreciation and love for Huyan Huanyan. Thinking of this, Xiao Feng fell into a deep sleep.
On the morning of the second day, all the princes and ministers arrived at the Qinzheng Hall early. After last night's discussion, each camp had come up with a result, so they all thought that this morning's meeting could finalize the matter of the four-dynasty competition, so that their master's hope of seizing the throne could be further improved.
"Your Majesty has arrived." Liu Yu's voice came. The courtiers who were whispering just now fell silent immediately. Xiao Dingfeng also sat on top and said directly: "About the competition between the four dynasties, we will draw lots this afternoon to determine the content of this competition. You can tell us what you think now."
The supporters of the respective princes immediately came out and asked their master to be the chief official this time. For a while, the ministers began to noisy back and forth as if they were buying vegetables in the vegetable market, while the prime minister and the neutral faction stood aside silently, as if this matter had nothing to do with them.
"That's enough! What's the noise like? Where do you think this is? Look at yourselves!" Xiao Dingfeng suddenly spoke with a mixture of momentum, causing the entire court to fall silent instantly.
All the ministers who were noisy just now stopped talking.
At this time, Xiao Dingfeng asked: "Prime Minister, who do you think should be in charge of this matter?"
"Your Majesty, Wei Chen decided that we should first determine the content of this competition. After it is determined, we should consider these. Wei Chen believes that we must make various preparations now. We must first determine the personnel who can represent our Rising Sun Dynasty. After the content of this competition is determined, we will arrange who will come. Host, no matter who is hosting this matter, it must be done under His Majesty's will, because this matter is related to the development of our Rising Sun Dynasty in the next five years. We were almost at the bottom of the last competition. We must get a good ranking this time, otherwise the younger generation will be too far behind. "
Xiao Dingfeng was a little surprised when he heard Huyan Moyan's words, because he knew that Xiao Feng visited Huyan Moyan yesterday, and he probably guessed that in addition to seeing Huyan Huanyan, more importantly, he went to discuss the competition with Huyan Moyan. What he didn't expect was that Huyan Moyan did not directly help Xiao Feng, which made Xiao Dingfeng very satisfied.
So he said: "Look at the structure of the Prime Minister. You are all vying for this position one by one, but you have not thought about the impact this position will have on this dynasty. If any of you can stand up and say that you can compete for the first place, then I will let whoever takes this position."
Xiao Dingfeng looked at all the princes, but all of them lowered their heads. Only Xiao Feng continued to look aside as if nothing had happened. Although he wanted to stand up, Huyan Moyan's words just now reminded him not to push forward, but to let nature take its course, so he did not stand up.
Xiao Dingfeng said: "The princes who want to participate will tell me soon. Dingnan of the clan, you can notify them and let them sign up with you if they meet the conditions. You can screen them."
"Wei Chen takes orders." Xiao Dingnan stood up and said.
"As for those of you who want to participate, you can get a discount. After the lottery is drawn in the afternoon, I will screen these people again."
"Xiao Kai, you will participate in the lottery with me this afternoon. As for the other princes, I will send someone to inform you of the results." After Xiao Dingfeng finished speaking, he announced his resignation.
When everyone saw Xiao Dingfeng leaving, they all exited the Qinzheng Palace. Several princes also walked out of the Qinzheng Palace and did not go to the Imperial Study Room because Liu Yu just came over and said that His Majesty would meet representatives of several other dynasties in the Imperial Study Room, so they did not have to go there. Only the eldest prince Xiao Kai followed Liu Yu to the Imperial Study Room.
Xiao Feng was also walking very slowly. He wanted to ask Huyan Moyan how to deal with this matter. When he walked out of the Qinzheng Hall, he saw Huyan Moyan waiting aside. Huyan Moyan watched Xiao Feng come out and walked up and said, "Go to my house. Didn't you make an appointment with Huanyan to accompany her in the afternoon?"
Xiao Feng nodded. After leaving the palace, Xiao Feng invited Huyan Moyan to sit in his carriage, so Huyan Moyan got on Xiao Feng's carriage. As soon as he entered the carriage, he saw Jia Xu waiting in the carriage. Huyan Moyan was stunned for a moment, obviously he did not expect that there was someone in the carriage.
After Xiao Feng sat in the car, he also introduced Huyan Moyan: "Father-in-law, this is my counselor, Jia Xu."
Jia Xu bowed and said, "See you, Prime Minister."
Huyan Moyan waved his hand and said: "You are Xiao Feng's counselor, so there is no need to be polite. I hope you will assist Feng'er more in the future."
"Wen He, I feel sorry for His Highness." Jia Xu also replied.
"Okay, don't be polite. We are all our own people, so don't be so intrusive."
